_doc: Colour correction of the zones' textures before tiling (TODO #5; color_zone.py, called by tile_zone.ps1). default: color_correct.py's options for every zone (target R,G,B; strength; alpha); zones.<id>: off (false: the texture as it is), the same options to override, and patches: color_patch.py's local corrections (box xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax,zmin,zmax in the OBJ's axes, y up; facing x,y,z; feather m; ratios G/R,B/R).
